description: Go ahead with an action from propose_action, after the user has seen its diff and agreed. Outcomes: applied (written to the store / Apple Ads account, 1 credit; when the org has an auto-apply rule the guardrail score clears, or allows agents to approve); pending_approval (a person must approve it in the AppGoat dashboard: give the user the approve link, nothing is written until then); needs a person (it was already pending and agents may not approve: hand over the link, do not retry); changed (the account changed since the dry run: the new diff is shown; show it to the user and call again with force=true only if they accept it, or propose_action again). Cost: 1 credit when applied, else 0 credits.

force.description: Apply the recomputed diff even though the account changed since the dry run. Only after the user has seen the new diff

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

name: apply_action
title: Apply Action
